# termux-aichain Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Sovereign Zero-Dependency Multimodal AI Framework for Android Edge & Termux
Engineered under the Zero-Heavy-Dependency doctrine: Pure Python stdlib and pure Node.js ESM orchestration for local llama-server, BitNet 1-bit models, state graphs, and native Termux hardware APIs.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-aichain
- Command: curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-aichain/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
# or manually:
pip install termux-aichain
npm install @termux-ai/chain
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-aichain

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero External Heavy Dependencies**: Pure Python standard library and pure Node.js ESM. Cold start import in under 18ms with less than 280KB disk footprint.
- **Full Multimodal ReAct Pipeline**: Seamless orchestration across STT voice capture, local BitNet/Llama reasoning, Playwright mobile web scraping, and Diffusion image synthesis.
- **Local Server Hardware Fine-Tuning**: 12 hardware tuning flags (threads, ctx, batch, GPU layers, FlashAttention, KV quantization, RoPE) for 0.5B to 14B models.
- **SQLite Long-Term Memory & RAG**: Persistent entity key-value storage and pure cosine vector search without ChromaDB or NumPy.
- **1-Line REST, SSE & Web Dashboard**: Exposes any agent over local mobile WiFi with Server-Sent Events, live chat, interactive graph visualizer, and trace profiler table.
- **Native Android Hardware Actuation**: Direct tool-calling wrappers for Termux-API (battery status, sensors, GPS location, STT, TTS, vibration) with kernel sysfs fallbacks.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import ameva_core as ac
engine = ac.Engine()
print(engine.compute([1.0, 2.0]))
```
